title: Edinburgh Award
description: Participated in a volunteering scheme to tutor secondary school pupils who are in disadvantaged areas in Scotland. This award is given at the end of volunteering, and aims to help students with exam-level Computer Science so they have a better chance at achieving their potential. The student was able to achieve an A at Advanced Higher in 2022 as a result of having personalized tutoring.

title: Edinburgh Award Co-Ordinator
description: Co-ordinated and organised tutor sessions between tutors of the tutoring scheme with their respective students.

title: Volunteer Computing Teaching Assistant
description: Volunteered in at a secondary school and aided the teacher in various classes between S2 and S5 to help students who were struggling and developed interpersonal and communicative skills to teach and transfer information in a way the student can understand.

title: Code Cadets Tutor
description:
Taught students at an after school club aged between 6 and 12 to introduce programming concepts such as sequencing, loops and conditionals weekly.

Managed different classes of roughly 20 students with students progressing quickly after the initial 4 weeks of joining the club.

Proactively looked for students who showed signs of struggle and identified root causes for struggle and addressed them.

title: Funtech Tutor
description: Taught virtually for students aged 11 to 18 on various technical concepts including basic Python (conditionals and loops), Object Oriented Programming, Game Development using Pygame and C++ and Memory management

title: Hardware Technician @ the University of Edinburgh
description:
Problem solving to manage tickets for different group projects within a module to produce 3D prints, soldering and fixing problematic hardware issues.

Answering any technical questions students may have about their project.

Consulted the lead technician for issues out of my control such as logistic or procurement issues before relaying a confident answer back to students.

title: Junior Software Engineer @ Dayshape
description: Managed many software development tasks including implementing frontend and backend work in C# and Vue from Jira tickets, contributed to feature delivery and collaborated with team members to ensure timely completion of projects.
